title: Thrillville: Off the Rails
trackingNote: The plugin reads your newest park save (AppData\Local\LucasArts\Thrillville 07\Save). The five story missions (Critics, Sabotage, Hypnosis, Robots, Traitor) unlock by themselves when the game saves after you finish them, and each park achievement (Explorer, Giant, Holiday, Otherworlds) once a save from that park has an open mission. Propaganda, The Rainbow and Disc Jockey unlock when you finish Propaganda Hunt!, Spray Away and Disc Collection (each is "collect all 6"); Coaster Boaster when you finish Whoa Designer or Whoa, Nelly! (build a brand new coaster); Putt putt power with Duffer's Paradise (build a mini golf course from pieces); Whoa with Whoa, Nelly! or Burning Circuits (a whoa coaster). Thrillville Talent, Sensation and Phenomenon unlock at park owner level 2, 5 and 10, read from the save's statistics. The mission names come from the game's own park files. The rest are marked by hand for now; Capture while I play still logs each mission that changes.
